'''Torian City''' was a [[City/Legends|city]] on the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Contruum/Legends|Contruum]].<ref name="STRONG" />

[[Airen Cracken/Legends|Airen Cracken]] ran a small mechanics shop in this city, working on [[Landspeeder/Legends|landspeeders]] and other vehicles.<ref name="STRONG" />
